snippet.title: PostCovidWorld® – Official Cinematic Showcase Trailer (2026)
snippet.description:
During the COVID-19 pandemic, as humanity struggled in chaos, a celestial entity approached Earth, forever changing the balance of nature. From the ashes of the old world, a new era begins.

PostCovidWorld® is an immersive open-world experience where survival, exploration, and combat define your destiny. Discover unique environments, dynamic weather systems, customizable characters, and multiple combat styles as you forge your path in a transformed world.

🌍 Features:
• Seven unique environment sets
• Dynamic weather system (Ice, Rain, and Clear conditions)
• Endless character customization
• Five distinct combat styles
• Immersive post-apocalyptic narrative
• Cinematic and atmospheric world

All footage captured in-game.
